
    <h2 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhangyy3/p/19176009" title="发布于 2025-10-30 09:57">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">阿里云 OSS postObject V4 使用</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <div class="postText"><div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>背景</h1>
<p>类似预签名的方式，后端生成了签名和policy, 前端使用表单提交。</p>
<h1>提示</h1>
<p>如果可以，尽量使用简单的方式，比如前端用accessKeyId+accessKeySecret 的方式直接putObject.但这种方法会暴露secret。</p>
<p>也可以通过自己服务后台上传到aliyun oss. 但这种方式会占用自己服务的带宽。</p>
<p>如果使用post Object 的方式，很麻烦，官方文档也的也不好(写的跟si一样)。调试了1天，帮doubao的帮助下才搞定。</p>
<h1>后端代码</h1>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> AliyunOssSignatureView genSignature() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception {

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 步骤1：创建policy。</span>
        ObjectMapper mapper = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ObjectMapper();

        Map</span>&lt;String, Object&gt; policy = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HashMap&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        policy.put(</span>"expiration"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, formatISODateTime());

        List</span>&lt;Object&gt; conditions = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArrayList&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

        Map</span>&lt;String, String&gt; bucketCondition = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HashMap&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        bucketCondition.put(</span>"bucket"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, bucketName);
        conditions.add(bucketCondition);

        Map</span>&lt;String, String&gt; signatureVersionCondition = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HashMap&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        signatureVersionCondition.put(</span>"x-oss-signature-version", "OSS4-HMAC-SHA256"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        conditions.add(signatureVersionCondition);

        Map</span>&lt;String, String&gt; credentialCondition = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HashMap&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        credentialCondition.put(</span>"x-oss-credential", accessKeyId + "/" + formatISODate() +  "/" + region + "/oss/aliyun_v4_request"); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 替换为实际的 access key id</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        conditions.add(credentialCondition);

        Map</span>&lt;String, String&gt; dateCondition = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> HashMap&lt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        dateCondition.put(</span>"x-oss-date"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, formateDateTimeZ());
        conditions.add(dateCondition);

        conditions.add(Arrays.asList(</span>"content-length-range", 1L, 1024L*1024*1024*5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
        conditions.add(Arrays.asList(</span>"eq", "$success_action_status", "201"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">        conditions.add(Arrays.asList("starts-with", "$key", "user/eric/"));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">        conditions.add(Arrays.asList("in", "$content-type", Arrays.asList("image/jpg", "image/png")));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">        conditions.add(Arrays.asList("not-in", "$cache-control", Arrays.asList("no-cache")));</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        policy.put(</span>"conditions"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, conditions);

        String jsonPolicy </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mapper.writeValueAsString(policy);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 步骤2：构造待签名字符串（StringToSign）。</span>
        String stringToSign = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String(Base64.encodeBase64(jsonPolicy.getBytes()));


        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 步骤3：计算SigningKey。</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] dateKey = hmacsha256(("aliyun_v4" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> accessKeySecret).getBytes(), formatISODate());
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] dateRegionKey =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hmacsha256(dateKey, region);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] dateRegionServiceKey = hmacsha256(dateRegionKey, "oss"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] signingKey = hmacsha256(dateRegionServiceKey, "aliyun_v4_request"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 步骤4：计算Signature。</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hmacsha256(signingKey, stringToSign);
        String signature </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BinaryUtil.toHex(result);
        log.info(</span>"policy:{}, base64 policy:{}, signature:{}"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, jsonPolicy, stringToSign, signature);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AliyunOssSignatureView(stringToSign, signature);
    }

 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] hmacsha256(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] key, String data) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化HMAC密钥规格，指定算法为HMAC-SHA256并使用提供的密钥。</span>
            SecretKeySpec secretKeySpec = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> SecretKeySpec(key, "HmacSHA256"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取Mac实例，并通过getInstance方法指定使用HMAC-SHA256算法。</span>
            Mac mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用密钥初始化Mac对象。</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            mac.init(secretKeySpec);

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 执行HMAC计算，通过doFinal方法接收需要计算的数据并返回计算结果的数组。</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] hmacBytes =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mac.doFinal(data.getBytes());

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> hmacBytes;
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception e) {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> RuntimeException("Failed to calculate HMAC-SHA256"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, e);
        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
     * 获取ISO格式时间
     * 2024-12-03T13:00:00Z
     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> current time iso format
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String formatISODateTime() {
        ZonedDateTime utcTime </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ZonedDateTime.now();
        utcTime </span>= utcTime.plusHours(1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> utcTime.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String formatISODate() {

        LocalDate utcDate </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LocalDate.now(ZoneOffset.UTC);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> utcDate.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> String formateDateTimeZ() {
        ZonedDateTime utcTime </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ZonedDateTime.now(ZoneOffset.UTC);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> utcTime.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd'T'HHmmss'Z'"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">其中region 一定要注意，是类似cn-beijing 这样的，而不是oss-cn-beijing.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">endpoint 是 https://bucketName.oss-cn-beijing.alyuncs.com</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">上面使用的base64是apache 的。不是java自带的</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>前端代码</h1>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">filed的顺序一定不能错，错了就不好使</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" width="1227" height="526" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1407482/202510/1407482-20251030094607473-1188338277.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;policy 和 x-oss-signature 都是后端生成返回给前端。</p>
<p>key 是上传后的文件名称</p>
<p>前端可以把policy base64 decode一下。在里面取x-oss-signature-version，x-oss-credential, x-oss-date，success_action_status这些值 。</p>
<p>file 是要上传的文件</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>参考文档</h1>
<p>https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/postobject</p>
<p>https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/signature-version-4-recommend?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.700a713f3JNlJV#79752ac45behk</p>
